qa_pair.question: Using only read-only calls, identify which MCP tool gives the fastest schedule hygiene snapshot before editing a user's whole task list. The answer must be the exact tool name.
A user asks which active top-level tasks have no schedule at all: no dueWithTime, no legacy plannedAt and no dueDay. Which exact MCP tool should an agent call first?
A user wants tasks planned between two local dates, grouped by day, with timed work ordered by time and day-only work listed after it. Which exact MCP tool provides that read-only view?
An agent must inspect archived tasks without mutating anything. Which get_tasks argument should be set to read only archived tasks?
An agent needs projectTitle, parentTitle, noteLength, subtaskCount, and isRecurring in task results. Which get_tasks boolean argument enables those synthetic fields?
A schedule rewrite should preview changes and avoid mutation by default. Which two arguments must be supplied to auto_schedule_tasks to actually apply changes?
A huge note must be compacted, but the bridge must not summarize it itself. Which exact argument must the caller provide to compact_task_notes?
True archive and restore require an optional local REST base URL. Name either accepted environment variable for that URL.
Which MCP resource exposes schedule hygiene counts and concise task lists without requiring a tool call?
An agent wants incomplete tasks planned today with concise synthetic metadata via a resource. Which resource URI should it read?

A weekly review needs tracked time that includes tasks archived during the week, and must say whether the total is complete. Which get_worklog argument includes archived work, and which result field reports completeness?

Before editing a recurring task's schedule, an agent wants to read its current repeat configuration and see which fields stock v20 lets it change. Which exact MCP tool, given the task's id, answers both?
make_planned_at refuses 2026-11-01 01:30 in America/Chicago because that wall time happens twice. Which argument picks one of the two instants?
An agent logged 30 minutes with add_time_to_task, got OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, and now knows the day's total should be exactly one hour. Which tool corrects it safely, even if called twice?
An agent wants to keep a task on Thursday but remove its 14:00 start time without losing the day. Which update_task argument, set to null, drops the time while dueDay keeps the day?
get_status answers isReady:false. Which field tells an agent whether only one of the configured adapters failed, so REST-routed tools may still work?
A user's report is due Friday, but they plan to work on it Wednesday. Which update_task argument records the Friday due date without moving the planned work?
Before suggesting a break, an agent checks whether the user is in a Pomodoro work session. Which read-only tool reports the focus timer, and what state value means a work timer is running?
A user forgot to record yesterday's six glasses of water. Which tool sets that day's habit value without adding to it, so repeating the call is safe?
A server runs with SP_MCP_SCOPES=read. Which additional scope must be granted before get_notes and the sp://notes resource become available?
An agent wants to move a note to another project and change its text. update_note refuses doing both at once. How many update_note calls does it need?
